question: Does the SPCP single-source synthetic subset preserve exact geometry and enough source-observable structural correspondence to support one later shared explicit colour-operator discriminant?
scientific_role: prospective pixel and alignment eligibility preflight only

bounded_program.stop_policy: do not continue indefinite after-only shared-bundle search; failure closes this family and preserves paired/capture-time metadata plus RAW/DNG/HDR/portable explicit-operator engineering as the durable path

eligible_scene_definition.interpretation: single original plus eleven synthetic ISP variants; this interpretation remains a structural hypothesis until pixel alignment passes

role_freeze.selection_key: sha256(UTF8('U5.R2SPCP1' + NUL + scene_id)); ascending; legacy seed retained exactly after identity-only correction to U5.R2SPCP3

pixel_preflight.download: exact ZIP member ranges only; no complete 9.05 GB archive
pixel_preflight.decode: exact canonical PNG, RGB conversion forbidden for geometry hashes
pixel_preflight.alignment_observation: tie-aware rank-gray Sobel gradients at full decoded geometry
pixel_preflight.registration: no fitted warp; phase-correlation translation is diagnostic and must remain within the frozen subpixel ceiling

stop_rules: Any role, archive member, CRC, size, decode, geometry or finite failure is INVALID_SOURCE_MECHANICS and closes before alignment interpretation.
Any development alignment gate failure closes the exact single-source synthetic family before confirmation read; no resize, warp, threshold, variant or scene rescue.
Any confirmation gate failure closes the family before operator fit; no same-cohort rescue.
A pass opens only the already-frozen future fit/calibration roles for one shared bounded source-free explicit operator; it does not open a content router, direct RGB model, product or rights claim.
identity_correction: The preregistration was initially committed under the already-occupied U5.R2SPCP1 name. It was renamed U5.R2SPCP3 after the first decode gate failure; the exact role manifest, legacy selection seed, selected members, gates and observed bytes were preserved without reselection.
claim_ceiling: At most, the exact SPCP single-source subset is geometrically suitable for a later private shared explicit-operator D0. No preference direction, operator value, generalization, product, package, schema, capability, rights or commercial claim.
